parameters.description:
Relay an SMS through your own Vonage account by posting a native Vonage payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`vonage-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `vonage_sms` payload that includes your credential field. The gateway forwards it to the upstream Vonage endpoint, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
